protocol.label: Experimental — limited training data.
protocol.selectionRule: Lowest pooled earlier-validation MAE on identical eligible pairs; lexical tie break
protocol.testRule: No October 3/5 diagnostics used or regenerated; later separate untouched confirmation only
protocol.purging: Every training and validation target interval ends by its split boundary
protocol.recentWindowRule: Restrict training origins; retain only origin-known older feature context
protocol.sharedModelRule: One estimator with explicit horizon; pooled rows are dependent, not extra price observations
protocol.blendRule: Fixed 25/50/75 percent HGB weight, chosen only on earlier validation; missing anchors unavailable

previousConfirmation.rule: Seven complete elapsed SGT days after freeze; fixed model/settings; no fitting in evaluation

limitations: Repeated development days are exploratory selection evidence, not an untouched test.
Overlapping horizons and shared-model rows are dependent; training sample count is not independent history.
Only six validation days in the current collector dataset; no consistent future accuracy claim.
Missing configured spike history prevents spike precision/recall claims.
Future confirmation pending; no serving/UI/production promotion changes.
